quest.title: Hanfeng's Iron-Mongering
quest.description: Hanfeng from Qingce Village needs ten Iron Chunks.

talks.objective: Give ten Iron Chunks to Hanfeng

dialogues.speaker: Hanfeng, "Cold Blade"
dialogues.text: Right, right... the commission I posted. So, have you brought me ten Iron Chunks?

response.speaker: Hanfeng, "Cold Blade"
response.text: Oh, well don't keep me waiting too long. The sooner I can get my tool fixed, the sooner I can carry on with my work.

dialogues.speaker: Hanfeng, "Cold Blade"
dialogues.text: These Iron Chunks should be just enough to fix my tool.

dialogues.speaker: Hanfeng, "Cold Blade"
dialogues.text: #I can't thank you enough. Here, these are for you, young {M#man}{F#lady}.

dialogues.speaker: Hanfeng, "Cold Blade"
dialogues.text: I just hope my skills haven't gotten too rusty now.
